scheme_name: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Caste
other_conditions: Applicant must be a small and poor farmer of Gujarat.
Applicant must have obtained a loan for setting up the unit in the financial year 2023‑24 through a nationalized bank or a financial institution approved by the Reserve Bank of India.
The land should be owned by a family member or the beneficiary of the scheme.
Applicant must obtain a certificate from the Animal Husbandry Authority.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 12% interest subsidy on loans for establishing a 1‑20 animal milk farm, payable via Direct Benefit Transfer for five years.
